results.title: Devils’ Nikita Shcherbakov Is the KHL Rookie of the Week
results.description: Salavat Yulaev Ufa defenseman Nikita Shcherbakov was awarded Rookie of the Week honors on Monday in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). The 18-years-old blueliner was picked by the New Jersey Devils in the second round of the 2026 NHL Entry Draft, 44th overall pick.

results.title: Bulldogs leash Patriots
results.description: MANCHESTER – The Burr and Burton Bulldogs boys soccer team defeated the Mount Anthony Patriots 7-0 Friday night at Friendship Field.
